title: Developing AI Apps and Agents on Azure
short: Azure AI apps and agents developer
description: Study guide, 64-skill tracker and a 60-question practice exam for the AI-103 exam, the successor to AI-102.
disclaimer: Original study material and practice questions based on public Microsoft documentation. Not Microsoft exam content; the real exam may differ.

domains.name: Plan and manage an Azure AI solution
Implement generative AI and agentic solutions

examInfo.label: Passing score
examInfo.value: 700 on a scale of 1 to 1,000 (a scaled score, not a percentage)

examInfo.label: Questions
examInfo.value: Not published for this exam; Microsoft says most exams have 40-60

examInfo.label: Time
examInfo.value: 120 minutes of exam time (seat time is longer)

examInfo.label: Languages
examInfo.value: English, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), French, German, Japanese, Korean, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish

examInfo.label: Delivery
examInfo.value: Pearson VUE: online proctored or test center

examInfo.label: Retakes
examInfo.value: 24 hours after the first fail, then 14 days; at most 5 attempts in 12 months

examInfo.label: Renewal
examInfo.value: Free, open-book assessment on Microsoft Learn; the window opens 6 months before expiry

examInfo.label: Microsoft Learn
examInfo.value: Opens in a split screen on associate and expert exams (per Microsoft policy); no extra time
